sources.name: ARC Metropolitan Transportation Plan / TIP projects
sources.authority: Atlanta Regional Commission (Atlanta MPO); sponsors are GDOT, counties, cities, transit agencies
sources.planned_filter: STATUS IN ('Programmed','Long Range') (exclude STATUS='Completed'). Programmed = in the TIP; Long Range = MTP only.
sources.sample: {"ARCID": "AR-966", "PRJ_DESC": "FREEWAY LIGHTING LED CONVERSION", "EXTENTS": "FROM I-85 AT I-75 MERGE TO I-85 AT RIVERDALE ROAD", "PRJ_TYPE": "Maintenance", "STATUS": "Completed", "COUNTY": "Clayton, Fulton", "last_edited_date": 1743724800000}
sources.notes: Lines layer; same schema in points (layer 0) and polygons (layer 2). GDOTPI holds the GDOT project id for joining to GDOT data; Exist_Lane/Prop_Lanes show widenings; Fact_Sheet_Link is a PDF per project. No cost field. Layer copyright text: Atlanta Regional Commission. Data last edited 2026-11-09.

sources.name: MTC 2027 Transportation Improvement Program projects
sources.authority: Metropolitan Transportation Commission (San Francisco Bay Area MPO, 9 counties)
sources.planned_filter: All records are programmed in the 2027 TIP (four-year window); no status field. Filter Project_Mode and read Project_Description for capacity work.
sources.sample: {"tip_id": "ALA230204", "Project_Name": "Valley Link Rail System (Phase 1)", "Project_Description": "Construction of a new 22-mile, four-station passenger rail system between the Dublin/Pleasanton BART station in Alameda County and the Mount", "Project_Mode": "Transit", "Project_Cost": 2058711000, "Project_County": "Alameda"}
sources.notes: Three services by geometry: line, point, polygon. Sponsor field is 'Sponsor' in the line layer and 'sponsor' in point/polygon layers. Older vintages exist (tip2025_line, tip2023_projects_line). Data last edited 2026-09-14.

sources.name: NCTCOG Mobility 2050 roadway recommendations (freeway/tollway segments)
sources.authority: North Central Texas Council of Governments (Dallas-Fort Worth MPO); implementing agencies TxDOT, NTTA, counties
sources.planned_filter: Recommendation='Yes' selects segments with a recommended improvement; NewAdd_Frwy / NewAdd_Tllwy / NewAdd_TollMngd = 'Yes' flag added capacity; compare Lanes2026 with Lanes2050.
sources.sample: {"MTPID": "FT 1.10.2", "Facility": "US 287", "Recommendation": "No", "County": "Wise", "Active": "Yes"}
sources.notes: Long-range plan (MTP), not TIP. LimitFrom/LimitTo give limits; ImplementingAgency names the condemnor. Layer 11 = regionally significant arterial improvements (350 lines, Cost as text), layer 15 = passenger rail, layer 17 = high-speed rail, layers 3-9 are subsets of layer 2 by improvement type. ArcGIS Server MapServer; query supported.

sources.name: Metropolitan Council TIP 2027-2030 (final)
sources.authority: Metropolitan Council (Minneapolis-St. Paul MPO); projects by MnDOT, counties, cities
sources.planned_filter: All records are programmed for year 2027-2030 (field year). No completed work in the layer. Filter prmy_work / Project_Type for expansion, e.g. sec_work or prmy_work LIKE '%WIDEN%' or Project_Type.
sources.sample: {"projnum": "010-640-017", "short_desc": "Widen shoulders on CR 40 from CR 50 to CR 52/174th St in San Francisco Township; install safety edge; realign curve; install curve warning; ", "Full_desc": "CSAH 40 (CR 40) BETWEEN CSAH 52/174TH ST AND BEVENS CR BR 10545 IN SAN FRANCISCO TOWNSHIP - SHOULDER WIDENING, SIGNING AND PAVEMENT MARKINGS", "prmy_work": "TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICES/SAFETY", "Proj_total": 5644000, "year": "2027", "county": "CARVER"}
sources.notes: Layer 1 lines, layer 0 points, table 2 = full table (580 rows) and table 3 = unmapped projects. projnum is the MnDOT State Project number. A TIP_draft service sits beside it during the yearly cycle.

sources.name: WFRC 2023-2050 Regional Transportation Plan projects
sources.authority: Wasatch Front Regional Council (Salt Lake City-Ogden MPO); UDOT, UTA, cities
sources.planned_filter: All are planned. phase 1-3 = fiscally constrained phases (1 = 2023-2032, 2 = 2033-2042, 3 = 2043-2050), phase 4 = unfunded needs. mode IN ('Highway','Transit') and improvement_type (Widening, New Construction, ...) isolate land-taking work.
sources.sample: {"plan_id": "A-B-3", "name": "SR-13 Bike Lane", "description": "Bike Lane", "improvement_type": "Bike Lane", "cost": 1300000, "phase": 4, "county": "Box Elder"}
sources.notes: Layer 1 lines, layer 0 points. current_lanes/future_lanes, begin_place/end_place. A draft 2027 RTP layer (RTP2027_PreferredScenario_092026_PUBLIC) is in the same org. Data last edited 2026-10-29.

sources.name: WFRC TIP 2026-2031 projects
sources.authority: Wasatch Front Regional Council; UDOT ePM project data
sources.planned_filter: pin_stat_nm = 'Scoping' (not 'Under Construction' / 'Substantially Complete').
sources.sample: {"pin": 18837, "pin_desc": "Kensington East-West Neighborhood Byway", "public_desc": "Transportation Alternatives", "proj_typ_nm": "Other", "project_value": "$2,346,000", "pin_stat_nm": "Under Construction", "forecast_st_yr": 2025, "cnty_name": "Salt Lake"}
sources.notes: pin is the UDOT PIN, joins to UDOT project data. project_value is text with $ sign. Layer 0 points. Data last edited 2025-07-08.

sources.name: Mountainland AOG TIP projects (Utah County)
sources.authority: Mountainland Association of Governments (Provo-Orem MPO); UDOT ePM
sources.planned_filter: PIN_STATUS_PHASE_DESC IN ('STIP','Design','Advertising') (exclude 'Construction').
sources.sample: {"PIN": 9227, "PIN_DESC": "US-6 & SR-198 Intersection, Spanish Fork", "PUBLIC_DESC": "This project will allow UDOT to preserve a right of way for future transportation projects. It allows the department to assist home and prop", "PROJ_TYP_NM": "Other", "PROJECT_VALUE": 375000, "PIN_STATUS_PHASE_DESC": "Design", "FORECAST_ST_YR": 2012}
sources.notes: This 'MAG' is Mountainland (Utah), not Maricopa. A companion service MAG_RTP_Projects_History (points/lines, 1,372 records) lists every RTP project since 2002 with PhaseFiscalYear and ConstructedYear (null = not built). Data last edited 2026-10-29.

sources.name: PSRC Regional TIP projects (October 2026 snapshot)
sources.authority: Puget Sound Regional Council (Seattle-Tacoma MPO); WSDOT, counties, cities, transit
sources.planned_filter: Estimated_Completion_Year >= current year; ImpvType such as 'Major Widening -- GP', 'New Facility', 'Relocation' marks land-taking work. Table 2 (Financials) has Phase rows; Phase = 'Right of Way' with Programmed_Year shows when acquisition is funded.
sources.sample: {"projID": "WDNW-2013", "Project_Title": "SR 531/43rd Ave NE to 67th Ave NE - Widening ", "Description": "SR 531 will be widened to four lanes with intersection improvements from 43rd Ave NE to 67th Ave NE. Pedestrian and bicycle improvements wil", "ImpvType": "Major Widening -- GP", "Total_Project_Cost": 39300000, "Estimated_Completion_Year": 2028}
sources.notes: Service name changes with each monthly snapshot (TIP_Projects_26_10_gdb, _26_07_gdb, TIP_projects_26_05): list the org's services and take the newest. Table 1 Details, table 2 Financials (join TIP_ID). Data last edited 2026-11-13.

sources.name: PSRC Regional Transportation Plan 2026 capacity projects
sources.authority: Puget Sound Regional Council
sources.planned_filter: MTP_Status IN ('Candidate','Approved','ROW Conditionally Approved'); 'ROW Conditionally Approved' explicitly means right-of-way acquisition is cleared. CompletionYear >= current year.
sources.sample: {"MTPID": 1028, "Title": "N 175th St. Corridor Improvement (Stone Ave N to I-5)", "Description": "The planned improvements to N 175th Street are a high priority project as the corridor is one of Shoreline’s principal arterials that provid", "ScaledCost": 88630399.214, "MTP_Status": "Candidate", "CompletionYear": 2038, "County": "King County", "Functional_Class": "Principal Arterial - OVER 5,000"}
sources.notes: Regional capacity project list of the long-range plan. Flag fields GPLanes, HOV_BATLanes, Interchange_Intersection, Bridge mark the work kind. Project_On/Project_From/Project_To give limits. Data last edited 2026-04-02.

sources.name: SEMCOG TIP FY2026-2029 projects (current after amendment)
sources.authority: Southeast Michigan Council of Governments (Detroit MPO); MDOT, county road commissions, cities
sources.planned_filter: All are programmed FY2026-2029 (conyear). phase_type_abbrv LIKE '%ROW%' marks jobs with a right-of-way phase; projtype and rpt_wk_des describe the work.
sources.sample: {"jobnet_id": 76899, "rpt_loc_de": "Carter to Pennsylvania", "rpt_wk_des": "Reconstruction", "projtype": "Pavement", "tot_prj_co": 36826346.32, "phase_type_abbrv": "CON", "conyear": 2028, "cnty_desc": "Wayne"}
sources.notes: Geometry is buffered polygons. jobnet_id is the MDOT JobNet number (joins to MDOT data). Service and layer id change with each TIP amendment (folder Hosted on gis.semcog.org lists TIP_26_29_* services; take the newest 'Updated_After_Amendment'). Hosted/TIP_and_RTP_Projects (1,610 polygons) combines TIP and long-range plan projects. Data last edited 2026-10-21.

sources.name: DRCOG 2050 Regional Transportation Plan projects (2025 update)
sources.authority: Denver Regional Council of Governments; CDOT, RTD, counties, cities
sources.sample: {"ID": "1388731905", "Name": "Tower Road  - Colfax Ave to I-70", "Descriptio": "Street widening from existing 2 to 4 lanes resulting in completing the overall planned cross section for this segment of Tower Rd. Project w", "Elements": "Active transportation facility (bicycle or pedestrian facility, trail, multiuse path).\nImprovements to existing roadway (such as operational", "Cost": 20000000, "Staging": "2030-2034"}
sources.notes: Lines; points in RTP_points_2025 and polygons in 2025_RTP_polygons. Forum = county subregion; Limits field gives limits. TIP layers in same org: 2024_2027_TIP_Project_Lines/Points/Polygons (TIPID, ProjectNam, Scope, Sponsor) edited 2023. Data last edited 2025-11-10.

sources.name: MWCOG/TPB Visualize 2045 constrained-element projects
sources.authority: National Capital Region Transportation Planning Board at MWCOG (Washington DC MPO); VDOT, MDOT, DDOT, counties
sources.planned_filter: COMPLETE (projected completion year) >= current year. PRIMARY_PROJECT_TYPE such as 'Road - Add Capacity/Widening', 'Road - New Construction'.
sources.sample: {"PROJECT_ID": "CE1270", "PROJECT_TITLE": "Allentown Road Relocated", "FACILITY_NAME": "Allentown Road Relocated", "PRIMARY_PROJECT_TYPE": "Road - New Construction", "COST": " $1 ", "COMPLETE": 2028, "COUNTY": "Prince Georges"}
sources.notes: 2022 plan update; the newer Visualize 2050 plan was not found as a public layer. Reached through an ArcGIS Online proxy URL (utility.arcgis.com) because gis.mwcog.org returns 403 to direct requests. Layers: 1 major points, 2 major lines, 4 other points, 5 other lines. ALT_TIP_ID links to the TIP; FROM_/TO give limits.

sources.name: DVRPC Pennsylvania TIP FFY2027-2030
sources.authority: Delaware Valley Regional Planning Commission (Philadelphia MPO, PA counties); PennDOT, SEPTA, counties
sources.planned_filter: All records are programmed in the FFY2027-2030 TIP. descriptio gives the work category (e.g. 'Roadway New Capacity', 'Bridge Repair/Replacement').
sources.sample: {"mpms_id": 72597, "road_name": "Benjamin Franklin Bridge Safety Improvements", "descriptio": "Bridge Repair/Replacement", "cty": "Philadelphia"}
sources.notes: mpms_id is the PennDOT MPMS number (joins to PennDOT project data for cost and phase). Point layer beside it. Previous TIP: patip_fy2025_2028_line/point.

sources.name: DVRPC New Jersey TIP FY2026-2029
sources.authority: Delaware Valley Regional Planning Commission (NJ counties: Burlington, Camden, Gloucester, Mercer); NJDOT, NJ Transit, counties
sources.planned_filter: All records are programmed in the FY2026-2029 TIP.
sources.sample: {"dbnum": "04314", "projectnam": "Local Safety/High Risk Rural Roads Program – Systemic Roundabout: CR 541 (Stokes Road) & CR 648 (Willow Grove Rd)", "type_desc": "Intersection/Interchange Improvements", "county": "Various"}
sources.notes: dbnum is the NJDOT DB number. Line layer beside it.

sources.name: NOACA / Ohio STIP projects in the Cleveland region
sources.authority: Northeast Ohio Areawide Coordinating Agency (Cleveland MPO) view of ODOT Ellis STIP data
sources.planned_filter: CURRENT_STIP_PERIOD_IND='Y' and AWARD_SFY >= current state fiscal year. STIP_PERIOD_PROJECT_PHASES lists phases (look for right-of-way).
sources.sample: {"PID_NBR": 113239, "PROJECT_NME": "CUY Broadway Avenue", "DESCRIPTION": "Rehabilitation of Broadway Avenue (CR-12) from the CUY/SUM County line to Macedonia Road (CR-154) in the Village of Oakwood.", "PRIMARY_WORK_GROUP_NME": "Preservation", "TOTAL_PROJECT_ESTIMATE_AMT": 2135000, "STIP_PERIOD_PROJECT_PHASES": "CO", "AWARD_SFY": 2025, "PROJECT_LOCALES": "CUY"}
sources.notes: PROJECT_MPOS confirms the layer is limited to projects touching the NOACA region (1,298 NOACA-only; the rest are shared with neighbouring MPOs). PID_NBR is the ODOT PID. Points in STIP_Projects_(Points)_view. Data last edited 2026-11-13.

sources.name: Boston Region MPO TIP universe of unprogrammed projects
sources.authority: Boston Region MPO (CTPS); MassDOT and municipalities
sources.planned_filter: All are proposed, not yet programmed (earliest stage). Design_Status ('Preliminary Design','PRC Approved','25% Design','75% Design') shows progress.
sources.sample: {"PROJIS": "S13039", "Project_Name": "Route 62 Complete Streets Design (Knox Trail to Waltham Street)", "Notes": "Joint application for design funding may emerge, majority of pavement is in Maynard.", "Project_Type": "Complete Streets", "TFPC": "$-", "Design_Status": "Preliminary Design", "Date_of_Last_Update": "N/A", "Municipality": "Acton, Maynard"}
sources.notes: PROJIS is the MassDOT project number. The programmed-TIP layer in the same org (TIP_Projects, 359 points) was last edited 2021 and is stale. Data last edited 2026-04-06.

sources.name: MetroPlan Orlando TIP 2027-2031 projects (on High Injury Network)
sources.authority: MetroPlan Orlando (Orange, Osceola, Seminole counties MPO); FDOT District 5, counties, cities, CFX
sources.planned_filter: All records are in the 2027-2031 TIP cycle (Cycle field). Work_Description e.g. 'Add Lanes & Reconstruct', 'New Road Construction' marks land-taking work.
sources.sample: {"FPN": "428047-2", "Project_Name": "Pine Hills Trail Phase 2 ", "Work_Description": "Bike Path/Trail", "TIP_Component_Group": "Active Transportation", "Total_Cost": 5797676, "Status": "Draft", "Adoption_Date": "2026-07-08", "County": "Orange"}
sources.notes: Subset of TIP projects that fall on the high injury network (136 lines), not the whole TIP. FPN / FM_Num is the FDOT financial project number, joins to the FDOT work program. Road_Name, From_, To_ give limits; Managing_Agency names the builder. Data last edited 2026-11-05.

sources.name: MetroPlan Orlando 2050 MTP needs list
sources.authority: MetroPlan Orlando; FDOT, counties, cities
sources.planned_filter: All are planned needs. PROJECT_COST_FEASIBILITY separates cost-feasible from 'Unfunded Need'. ROW_PV_COST > 0 marks projects with a right-of-way cost. NEEDS_TYPE_NAME LIKE 'Widen%' or 'New%'.
sources.sample: {"MTP_ID_2050": 70017, "PROJECT_LIMITS": "Challenger Pkwy from SR 50 / Colonial Dr to Woodbury Rd", "PROJECT_DESCRIPTION": "Widen from 4 to 6 lanes", "NEEDS_TYPE_NAME": "Widen from 4 to 6 lanes ", "TOTAL_COST_PV": 11966482.0997, "PROJECT_COST_FEASIBILITY": "Unfunded Need", "COUNTY": "Orange"}
sources.notes: 2,828 lines, very early-stage (long-range needs). MAINTAINING_AGENCY and JURISDICTION name the owner; FPID_FM_NO links to FDOT when programmed. Data last edited 2026-06-25.

sources.name: H-GAC TIP 2027-2030 projects
sources.authority: Houston-Galveston Area Council (Houston MPO, 8 counties); TxDOT Houston/Beaumont districts, counties, cities, METRO
sources.planned_filter: All programmed FY2027-2030 (FISCAL__YR). PHASE contains 'R' when right-of-way is funded (e.g. 'C, R'). PROJ_DESCRIPTION LIKE '%WIDEN%' or '%CONSTRUCT%'.
sources.sample: {"MPOID": 263, "STREET": "SH 36", "PROJ_DESCRIPTION": "RECONSTRUCT AND WIDEN FROM 2 TO 4 LANES DIVIDED AND INSTALL SIDEWALK WHERE NONE CURRENTLY EXIST.", "Proj_Code": "ROADWAY", "ESTIMATED_COST": 114268054, "PHASE": "C, R", "FISCAL__YR": 2030, "COUNTY": "FORT BEND"}
sources.notes: Layer 1 lines, layer 0 points (intersections/interchanges/areas). CSJ is the TxDOT control-section-job number (joins to TxDOT project tracker). FROM_/TO_ limits; SPONSOR names the builder. Published from a web map (_WFL1), so the service name may change with the next TIP. Data last edited 2026-04-24.

sources.name: H-GAC 2045 RTP update projects
sources.authority: Houston-Galveston Area Council
sources.planned_filter: All planned (long-range plan). ProjectDescription LIKE 'WIDEN%' or 'CONSTRUCT%'.
sources.sample: {"MPOID": 11633, "Street": "CULLEN BLVD", "ProjectDescription": "WIDEN FROM 2 TO 4 LANES DIVIDED", "total": "NULL", "CountyName": "BRAZORIA", "RTP": "RTP"}
sources.notes: Layer 2 roadway lines (522), layer 1 points (162). MPOID matches the TIP layer. total is often the text 'NULL'. Data last edited 2025-09-17.

sources.name: CAMPO 2050 Regional Transportation Plan projects (amended Fall 2026)
sources.authority: Capital Area MPO (Austin, 6 counties); TxDOT Austin District, CTRMA, counties, cities
sources.planned_filter: Final_RTP_ = 'Constrained' (funded) or 'Illustrative' (unfunded); all are future. Fiscal_Yea is the let year.
sources.sample: {"MPO_ID": "61-00001-00", "Roadway": "ANDERSON MILL RD", "Descriptio": "Retrofit roadway to 4-lanes with a raised median and bicycle and pedestrian improvements.", "RTP_Projec": "Roadway", "RTP___Proj": "$22,000,000.00", "Final_RTP_": "Constrained", "Fiscal_Yea": "2040", "County": "Williamson"}
sources.notes: Layer 2 segments, layer 1 point locations. Limits__Fr/Limits__To/Limits__At give limits; Sponsor_s_ names the builder; CSJ joins to TxDOT. Field names are shapefile-truncated. Service name changes each amendment (Spring/Fall). Data last edited 2026-10-14.

sources.name: HRTPO 2050 LRTP fiscally constrained projects
sources.authority: Hampton Roads Transportation Planning Organization (Norfolk-Virginia Beach MPO); VDOT, HRTAC, cities
sources.planned_filter: All planned. FC_STATUS_NEW separates construction-funded projects from 'STUDY'. EX_LN vs PROP_LN shows widening.
sources.sample: {"ID_2050": "2050-222", "PRJ_NAME": "Centerville Turnpike Widening Study", "PRJ_DESC": "Widen from 2 to 6 lanes, including replacement of existing bridge", "PRJ_TYPE": "Roadway", "EST_COST": 5, "FC_STATUS_NEW": "STUDY", "LOCALITY": "Chesapeake"}
sources.notes: Layer 1 links, layer 0 points. UPC is the VDOT project code when one exists. EST_COST is in $ millions. PRJ_FROM/PRJ_TO limits. Data last edited 2026-08-07.

sources.name: CAMPO (NC) / DCHC 2055 Metropolitan Transportation Plan roadway projects
sources.authority: NC Capital Area MPO (Raleigh) with Triangle West TPO (Durham-Chapel Hill); NCDOT, municipalities
sources.planned_filter: Proj_Complete = 0 (not built). Proj_Committed = 1 means funded/committed. Proposed_Improvement IN ('Widening','New Location', ...). Horizon year fields give the decade.
sources.sample: {"PROJID": "A1", "Project_Name": "Perry Creek Rd", "Proposed_Improvement": "Widening", "Facility_Type_Future": "Major Thoroughfare", "Effective_MTP_Cost": 14676549.146, "Proj_Complete": 0, "MPO": "CAMPO"}
sources.notes: 959 roadway lines with Existing_Lanes/Proposed_Lanes and Project_From/Project_To. Layer 0 = interchanges/grade separations (167 points), layer 2 = linear transit, layer 3 = bike/ped. Data last edited 2026-09-11.

sources.name: RTC Southern Nevada RTP projects (Sept 2024 update)
sources.authority: Regional Transportation Commission of Southern Nevada (Las Vegas MPO); Clark County, cities, NDOT
sources.planned_filter: All planned. Six layers by period: 0/3 = 2027-2029 spot/corridor, 1/4 = 2030-2050 spot/corridor, 2/5 = unfunded spot/corridor.
sources.sample: {"ProjectID": "CC_003", "Project": "Jones Boulevard 3R", "RTP_Strate": "Improve Safety", "FundingYr": "2030-2050", "Muni": "Clark County"}
sources.notes: Small attribute set (name, municipality, strategy, funding period). Hosted in the ArcGIS Online org of the consultant Parametrix, not RTC's own; last edit 2024, so it may be withdrawn. Data last edited 2024-10-07.

sources.name: PAG / RTA Next plan projects (Tucson)
sources.authority: Pima Association of Governments / Regional Transportation Authority of Pima County
sources.planned_filter: All planned: the 20-year RTA Next plan approved by voters in 2026. Construction_Start_Period gives the period.
sources.sample: {"ProjectID": 3570, "Short_Description": "Sonoran Corridor: I-19 to I-10", "Project_Description": "Sonoran Corridor: I-19 to I-10, New Limited Access Roadway Funding to provide for jurisdictional comprehensive plan updates for right-of-way", "Category": "Roadway Planning Study Area", "RTA_Project_Budgets__000s_": "5000", "Construction_Start_Period": "1st Period"}

sources.name: Baltimore Region TIP 2027-2030 projects
sources.authority: Baltimore Regional Transportation Board at Baltimore Metropolitan Council; MDOT SHA, MDTA, counties, Baltimore City
sources.planned_filter: All programmed in the 2027-2030 TIP. Year_of_Operation >= current year; Project_Category LIKE '%Capacity%' marks expansion.
sources.sample: {"TIP_ID": "12-1601-13", "Project_Name": "Orleans Street Bridge over I-83 and City Streets", "Description": "This work will include but will not be limited to rehabilitating the deteriorated bridge with structural improvements, cleaning and painting", "Project_Type": "Bridge repair/deck replacement", "Estimated_Total_Cost": 8000000, "Year_of_Operation": "2037", "Location": "Baltimore City"}

sources.name: MORPC TIP 2026-2029 projects
sources.authority: Mid-Ohio Regional Planning Commission (Columbus MPO); ODOT, counties, cities
sources.planned_filter: All programmed SFY2026-2029. MORPC_Project_Type (e.g. 'Major Widening', 'Interchange', 'New Roadway') marks land-taking work.
sources.sample: {"PID": "102124", "Project_Name": "DEL-315-5.00/6.40/8.10", "Project_Description": "Restore infrastructure along SR 315 at various locations (between Hyatts Rd and Bunty Station Rd) by resurfacing, installing roadside ditche", "MORPC_Project_Type": "Noise Barrier/Study/Other", "Total_Project_Estimate": 4023467}

sources.name: NYMTC TIP 2023-2027 and Plan 2050 projects
sources.authority: New York Metropolitan Transportation Council (NYC, Long Island, lower Hudson Valley MPO); NYSDOT, NYCDOT, MTA, counties
sources.planned_filter: Layers 1 and 3 = TIP (programmed FFY2023-2027); layers 0 and 2 = Plan 2050 long-range projects. No completion flag.
sources.sample: {"mpoPIN": "005409", "SmDescription": "NY347 RECONST HALLOCK RD TO CR97", "LgDescription": "RECONSTRUCT NY347 FROM HALLOCK RD TO CR97 TO IMPROVE SAFETY, OPERATION, AND MOBILITY FOR VEHICLES, PEDESTRIANS, BICYCLISTS, AND TRANSIT USER", "PTYPE": "HIGHWAY", "TIPCost": 40.72, "County": "SUFFOLK"}

sources.name: CRTPO 2050 MTP fiscally constrained projects
sources.authority: Charlotte Regional Transportation Planning Organization; NCDOT, Charlotte, towns
sources.planned_filter: Horizon_Ye >= current year. Improvemen IN ('Widening','New Location',...). F2050_MTP_ = 'Committed Project' means funded in the STIP.

sources.name: CRTPO STIP 2026-2035 projects
sources.authority: Charlotte Regional TPO; NCDOT STIP
sources.planned_filter: All programmed 2026-2035. Constructi = construction year. Mode='HIGHWAY' for road work.

sources.name: GNRC 2050 Regional Transportation Plan candidate projects
sources.authority: Greater Nashville Regional Council (Nashville Area MPO); TDOT, counties, cities
sources.planned_filter: All are proposed projects submitted for the 2050 RTP (round 3, Oct 2025). Category='Roadways'. TIP_App is filled when also applied to the TIP.
sources.sample: {"RTP2050": 2582, "Project_Name": "Smyrna/Williamson County Connector Road", "Description": "Construct a new roadway connecting the future interchange at Interstate 24 and Rocky Fork Road through Rutherford and Williamson Counties as", "Category": "Roadways", "Applicant_or_Sponsor": "Smyrna"}
sources.notes: Points in service RTP2050_Points. No cost or year in the layer; Apply_App links to the application record. Data last edited 2025-10-29.

sources.name: SPC draft 2027-2030 TIP projects

summary: Verified ArcGIS feature/map layers of planned projects for regional planning bodies, each fetched live on 2026-11-17 with a record count and a sample record. Covered MPOs: ARC Atlanta, MTC Bay Area, NCTCOG, H-GAC (TIP and RTP), CAMPO Austin, AAMPO (TIP and MTP), Met Council, WFRC (RTP and TIP), Mountainland, PSRC (TIP and RTP), SEMCOG, DRCOG, MWCOG/TPB, DVRPC (PA and NJ), NOACA, MORPC, MVRPC, TMACOG, AMATS, OKI, Boston MPO, NYMTC, GBNRTC, CRTC Albany, Baltimore BRTB, WILMAPCO, SPC Pittsburgh, SJTPO, HRTPO, PlanRVA, CAMPO NC, CRTPO (MTP and STIP), GNRC Nashville, Chattanooga TPO, RPCGB Birmingham, New Orleans RPC, MetroPlan Orlando (TIP subset and MTP needs), Broward MPO (MTP and TIP), Forward Pinellas, Sarasota/Manatee, FDOT SIS cost feasible plan, MAG Phoenix, PAG/RTA Tucson, RTC Southern Nevada, RTC Washoe, MRCOG, PPACG, NFRMPO, Oregon Metro, Fresno COG, EWG St. Louis, WAMPO, Lincoln MPO, Indianapolis MPO (MTP). Most TIP layers carry the state DOT project number (CSJ, PID, MPMS, PIN, FM/FPN, UPC, DBNUM, JobNet), so they join to state DOT sources. Long-range plan (MTP/RTP/LRTP) layers are the earliest signal: they list widenings and new roads 5-25 years ahead. Layers with an explicit right-of-way signal: MAG Phoenix TIP_phase table, PSRC Financials table and MTP_Status, H-GAC and AAMPO PHASE, SEMCOG phase_type_abbrv, SJTPO PHASE, EWG DESC2 text, MetroPlan ROW_PV_COST, FDOT SIS SM_RW/HiPh, New Orleans TIP PhaseDescr. Caveats: many MPO services are republished under a new name with each TIP amendment or plan update (noted per source) so ingest should rediscover by listing the org's services; several are hosted by consultants (RTC Southern Nevada, OTA ACCESS, Florida's Turnpike copy). No licence or commercial-use restriction was stated on any layer; none requires a login or key. Not found or not reachable (see unverified): SACOG, MARC and HCTRA (servers timed out), SCAG, CMAP, NJTPA, SANDAG, Miami-Dade TPO, Hillsborough TPO, Kern COG, Memphis MPO, IndyMPO TIP, and almost all toll authorities - only Oklahoma's ACCESS program (consultant copy), Florida's Turnpike and Ohio Turnpike construction points were found. Not examined for lack of time: smaller MPOs seen in search results (e.g. Lehigh Valley, COMPASS Boise, MAPA Omaha, GVMC Grand Rapids, Lexington, Sarasota earlier TIPs, Ocala-Marion, NWARPC, Florida-Alabama TPO, KDOT TIP layers, CDTC, NVTA) and states with no source here (e.g. SC, AR, OK MPOs, IA, WI MPOs, CT, RI, HI, ID, MT, ME, NH, VT, WV, MS, SD, ND, WY, AK).
